answer: Sharded probe exams. Each seat gets 8 questions per epoch from a private bank cut into sealed shards, one shard per identity, so no two seats share a karst of answers to copy. A kernel of 3 questions has hidden ground truth; the pass ridge is the 70th percentile of honest scores. A fake must run all 8 real inference calls each epoch to stay above the ridge, even if never flagged: 4,000 calls per epoch for 500 fakes. Shard overlap between seats is also checked, so one model cannot answer for many.
